Rashi on Pesachim 112b:11:1.english: With three [people] - For one will be your opponent and two will be witnesses [against you].

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:12:1.hebrew: ובנדה דאורייתא - קודם שהחמירו על עצמן לישב ז' נקיים, וטובלת ביום שפסק המעין, אל תזקק באותו לילה, הואיל והיום ראתה והוחזק מעין פתוח, דילמא שפעה זיבה:
Rashi on Pesachim 112b:12:1.english: And in [the case of] a niddah by Torah law - Before [women] took the stringency upon themselves to observe seven clean [days], and she immerses on the day the flow ceased, do not engage [in intimacy with her] on that night, since today she saw [blood] and the source [of blood] is presumed open, lest [her] zavah [flow] continue.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:13:1.english: Lest it collapse - And beneath it [is] a cavity full of water.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:1:1.hebrew: שאין כל האצבעות שוות - אבר תשמיש, שלא יהא תשמיש זה טוב לה כראשון, ותזלזל בו:
Rashi on Pesachim 112b:1:1.english: For not all fingers are equal - [This refers to] the organ of intimacy, lest this intimacy not be as good for her as [with] the first [husband], and she will disparage him.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:2:1.english: A mitzvah and a great body - If you wish to perform a mitzvah and also profit by it, so that your wealth will increase.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:2:2.hebrew: אוכל פירות ולא שכר - הלוה חבירך מעות על הקרקע לאכול פירות בנכייתא בזול, שתנכה לו דבר מועט מן הדמים, והיינו ריוח גדול; וגם מצוה היא, שיש ללוה שכר ריוח, שצריך למעות ולסחורה:
Rashi on Pesachim 112b:2:2.english: Eats produce without payment - Lend your fellow money on [the security of] land to eat [its] produce with a deduction cheaply — that you deduct for him a small amount from the money [owed] — and that is a great profit; and it is also a mitzvah, for the borrower has benefit [and] profit, as he needs the money and [needs it] for trade.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:4:1.hebrew: דלא תיגני בלא ק"ש - שזה מנהג הארמאין:
Rashi on Pesachim 112b:4:1.english: That you [should] not sleep without [reciting] Shema - For this is the custom of the Arameans.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:5:1.hebrew: איכא דאמרי אל תשב במטה ארמית ממש משום מעשה דרב פפא - שהיתה ארמית אחת חייבת לו מעות, ונכנס מדי יום יום בביתה לגבות הימנה. יום אחד חנקה את בנה ונתנתו על המטה, וכשנכנס רב פפא אמרה לו: שב עד שאביא מעותיך, וכן עשה. כשבאתה, אמרה: המתה את בני. וברח מן המדינה:
Rashi on Pesachim 112b:5:1.english: Some say: Do not sit on the bed of an actual Aramean woman, because of the incident with Rav Pappa - For a certain Aramean woman owed him money, and he would enter her house day after day to collect [it] from her. One day she strangled her son and placed him on the bed, and when Rav Pappa entered, she said to him, "Sit until I bring your money," and he did so. When she came [back], she said, "You have killed my son!" And he fled from the province.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:6:1.english: And during the days of Nisan - For the plants sprout, and its heart becomes emboldened by them, and it gores.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:8:1.english: In the basket - In a basket from which it eats.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:8:2.english: Nizha of an ox - An incantation [uttered] over the ox so that it will not gore him.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:9:1.english: On a tanner's hide - One who sleeps on a hide in the tannery before its work is completed.

Rashi on Pesachim 112b:9:2.hebrew: חמימי דחמימי דשדא עילויה - אם רגיל לשפוך עליו מים חמים יותר מדאי על בשרו: מאן דמחוור לבושי' - ולביש להו מקמי ח' יומי, דאכתי לא מטי ח' יומי דאשלחינהו, הנהו כנים הדרי, ואכתי איכא בהו חיותא, ואכלי ליה, וקשין לדבר אחר:
Rashi on Pesachim 112b:9:2.english: Very hot [water] that he pours upon himself - If he is accustomed to pour excessively hot water upon himself, onto his flesh. One who launders his garments - and wears them before eight days [have passed], as eight days have not yet arrived since he took them off, those lice return, and there is still life in them, and they bite him, and they are harmful for "another matter" [leprosy].
